meta.title: Lba Cra And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 2 of 2025, adopting the Final Budget for Fiscal Year 2025-26 of the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority
votes.description: Adopts the LBA Capital Projects Fund budget for FY2025-26, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries. The LBA serves as a financing tool for capital projects at better interest rates.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and convene as the Community Reinvestment Agency
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA meeting and open the CRA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 10 of 2025, approving the Fiscal Year 2026 CRA Budget reflected in the attached Key Changes spreadsheet
votes.description: Adopts the Community Reinvestment Agency's annual budget for FY2026. The CRA manages tax increment financing districts for community reinvestment projects in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Community Reinvestment Agency and convene as the Salt Lake City Council
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the CRA meeting and open the City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 15 of 2025, recognizing June 19, 2025 as Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City
votes.description: Ceremonial resolution jointly with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing Juneteenth Freedom Day on June 19, 2025 in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 32 of 2025, approving Salt Lake City's Fiscal Year 2025-26 budget excluding the schedule for capital projects and debt and the Library Fund, including contingent appropriations as listed on the motion sheet under Motion #2, Items A and B
votes.description: Adopts the main City operating budget for FY2025-26, excluding the Library Fund, along with the employment staffing document. Includes contingent appropriations as specified in the motion sheet.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 31 of 2025, approving the budget for the Library Fund of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2025-26
votes.description: Adopts the Library Fund budget separately from the main City budget for FY2025-26, as required by law.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 33 of 2025, setting the final rate of tax levy including the final levy for the Library Fund for Fiscal Year 2025-26, and authorize the Council Chair to sign necessary documentation for the State Tax Commission
votes.description: Sets the FY2025-26 property tax rate of 0.003180 per dollar of taxable valuation, allocated across the General Fund, Library Fund, General Obligation Bonds, and Governmental Immunity Fund. Also directs the Attorney's Office to review recent tax advice regarding combining the Library and City as one tax entity.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 34 of 2025, amending various fees and fee information set forth in the Salt Lake City Consolidated Fee Schedule
votes.description: Amends the City's Consolidated Fee Schedule for FY2025-26, updating various fees across City departments and services.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 35 of 2025, approving a compensation adjustment for elected and statutory officers and executive municipal officers of Salt Lake City
votes.description: Approves compensation adjustments for elected officials, statutory officers, and executive municipal officers as part of the FY2025-26 budget process.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 37 of 2025, approving a compensation plan for all non-represented employees of Salt Lake City
votes.description: Adopts the FY2025-26 compensation plan governing pay for City employees who are not represented by a collective bargaining unit.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 36 of 2025, appropriating necessary funds to implement for Fiscal Year 2025-26 the provisions of the MOU between Salt Lake City and AFSCME Local 1004
votes.description: Appropriates funding to implement the collective bargaining agreement with AFSCME Local 1004 for FY2025-26, covering eligible City employees represented by that union.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 38 of 2025, appropriating the necessary funds to implement for Fiscal Year 2025-26 the provisions of the MOU between Salt Lake City and the International Association of Firefighters Local 81
votes.description: Appropriates funding to implement the collective bargaining agreement with the International Association of Firefighters Local 81 for FY2025-26, covering eligible firefighter employees.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 39 of 2025, amending Section 2.54.030 of the Salt Lake City Code to update policies and restrictions related to the use of City owned motor vehicles
votes.description: Updates the City Code governing the use of City-owned motor vehicles, revising policies and restrictions related to take-home vehicle use by City employees.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 40 of 2025, amending Sections 12.56.140, 12.56.150, 12.56.160 and 12.56.200 of the Salt Lake City Code to update time frames, dates, and processes related to parking and parking enforcement
votes.description: Updates City Code provisions governing parking enforcement, including time frames, dates, and related administrative processes.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 41 of 2025, amending sections of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to the responsibilities of the Department of Public Services and the Department of Community and Neighborhoods
votes.description: Reallocates responsibilities between the Department of Public Services and the Department of Community and Neighborhoods by amending relevant City Code sections.

votes.motion: Defer the Ordinance amending Title 2 Administrative Organization for the Sustainability Department (Item H12) to a future meeting date
votes.description: Postpones action on the proposed ordinance updating Section 2.08.120 regarding the Sustainability Department's functions and responsibilities to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 42 of 2025, amending Chapter 17 of the Salt Lake City Code complying with rate study and regulatory requirements
votes.description: Updates Title 17 of the City Code to align with proposed water, sewer, and stormwater rate structures and to comply with regulatory requirements as requested by the Department of Public Utilities.

votes.motion: Adopt $55,806,110 to be transferred into CIP, including approving $13,489,253 in funding as shown on the motion sheet; further CIP project-specific allocations to be considered later in the year
votes.description: Approves the overall Capital Improvement Program funding transfer for FY2025-26 and specific allocations totaling $13,489,253, with remaining project-specific allocations to be determined later in the year.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinances A-K as shown on the Motion Sheet relating to the Fiscal Year 2025-26 budget, with the exception of Item I (Ordinance: Amending Title 2 Administrative Organization for the Sustainability Department), which will be deferred to a future meeting date
votes.description: Omnibus motion adopting the suite of FY2025-26 budget-related ordinances (Items H4 through H13 and H15) as a group, excluding the Sustainability Department ordinance which was deferred.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 17 of 2025, authorizing the Mayor to enter into the proposed addendum No. 9 to the Interlocal Agreement with UTA to implement 2025-26 Frequent Transit Network (FTN) service
votes.description: Authorizes the Mayor to sign Addendum No. 9 to the 20-year interlocal agreement with the Utah Transit Authority, funding frequent bus service (every 15 minutes) on routes along 200 South, 900 South, 2100 South, and 1000 North/South Temple for FY2025-26.

votes.motion: Adopt the Legislative Intent Statements as outlined on the motion sheet under Motion 5, Items 1 through 10
votes.description: Adopts ten legislative intent statements associated with the FY2025-26 budget, directing the administration on various policy matters identified by the Council.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 43 of 2025, annexing certain unincorporated properties north-northeast of the Salt Lake International Airport and near the Salt Lake County border with Davis County, and adopt a Legislative Action requesting the administration to review the property at approximately 2699 West 3300 North for potential rezoning to M1-A
votes.description: Annexes the Northpoint area properties into Salt Lake City limits and directs the administration to review a specific parcel for potential M1-A rezoning as part of the annexation implementation.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda
votes.description: Approves all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for a zoning text amendment and CIP resolution, and approving board appointments/reappointments for Jonathan Freedman to the Airport Board and Jenny Bonk and Brad Christensen to the CDCIP Advisory Board.
